newsitem.title: USA: CENIT says advisory firm supports board.
newsitem.headline: CENIT says advisory firm supports board.

text.p: Institutional Shareholder Services, an independent advisory firm that reviews and analyzes proxy issues, has advised investors in CENIT Bancorp to vote in favor of the recommendations of CENIT's board at the upcoming annual meeting, CENIT said Friday.
CENIT has recommended that shareholders reject the proxy proposal and board nominees of the Mid-Atlantic Investors Group.
Michael Ives, president and chief executive officer of CENIT, said the ISS assessment "recognizes the values inherent in CENIT's current management strategy."
